gen-tourney-gf-kedebideri: Wide-tracked and stocky, Tourney hits hard. Kedebideri sits beneath it with rounded, open sans letters and a high x-height, so the loud heading gets a friendly, easygoing partner on the page.
gen-tourney-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and level-headed, with a tall midsection and curves that keep their mouths open. Tourney, with its marker-nib line that ignores direction, supplies all the punch up top.
gen-tourney-gf-krub: Blunt and sporty, Tourney draws every stroke at a single width, while Krub brings a pronounced x-height. Its sans-serif curves lift off before closing, loosening the heading's weight gently.
gen-tourney-gf-matangi: Tourney stretches its words with wide tracking and bulky little lowercase. Matangi, a hefty sans with rounded, open letters, gives paragraphs a pressed-twine texture that stays easy going down.
gen-tourney-gf-michroma: Tourney is loud and wide, a constant outline you could trace. Michroma, a plain sans with wide-berthed letters and tall bodies, reads spaciously, each line unspooling with room to breathe.
gen-tourney-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline is a plain sans with big, round bowls. Tourney, wide and bulky with strokes of constant width, does the shouting while those open bowls quietly carry the reading.
gen-tourney-gf-mozilla-headline: Tourney looks stretched and stocky, with no thin strokes anywhere. Mozilla Headline meets that bulk with big-bodied sans lowercase and a splayed c terminal, and the shared heft is the whole appeal.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Tourney does its best work shouting in stretched, bulky letters, while the sans below does its best work in tall, full c, s and z shapes.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Marker-blunt and stretched wide, Tourney means business. The heading excels at round-tipped, bulky impact, while Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs excels at outward-pointing terminals and a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Tourney stretches its bulky letters wide, with curves that never thin out at any of the turns. Noto Sans Avestan, a plain sans, rewards a slightly larger size than usual.
